findings.detail: Seventeen validated model-risk and AI RMF units resolve with exact source, unit and fidelity hashes.
Eight current section bindings cover the two selected notes.
A new receipt uses globally unique evidence references while preserving the original source IDs, unit hashes, locators and fidelity inputs.
SR 26-2 and SR 11-7 remain bounded to their supervisory scope; NIST AI RMF is framework context.
Forty-five other publication-lineage warnings remain outside this bounded lot and are listed in provenance-gaps.md.
